import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

COLW = 96
FEAT = 48
CTX = 40
RAW = 16
HID = 32
GW = 64

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}


def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.exact = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(c, hid, (dy, dx))) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, p):
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), ex, out in zip(self.fps, self.exact, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(ex(q))))
        return torch.cat(res, 1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.col1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, COLW, 1))
        self.gn0 = nn.GroupNorm(8, COLW)
        self.col2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COLW, FEAT, 1))
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(FEAT, CTX, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn1 = nn.GroupNorm(8, CTX)
        self.c2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn2 = nn.GroupNorm(8, CTX)
        self.raw = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, RAW, 1))
        self.proj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(FEAT + CTX + RAW, FEAT, 1))
        self.head = FootHead(FEAT, spec.footprints, HID)
        self.anchor = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(FEAT, 1, 1), 0.01)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * (FEAT + CTX), GW)), nn.ReLU())
        self.type_term = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_types), 0.01)
        self.dense = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_place), 0.01)
        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)
        self.value = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = F.relu(self.gn0(self.col1(obs)))
        c = F.relu(self.col2(c))
        x = F.relu(self.gn1(self.c1(c)))
        x = F.relu(x + self.gn2(self.c2(x)))
        r = self.raw(obs)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(torch.cat([c, x, r], 1)))
        feats = torch.cat([c, x], 1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([feats.mean((2, 3)), feats.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        place = self.head(p) + self.anchor(p) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        place = place.flatten(1) + self.dense(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
RAW = 16

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.003, "clip_eps": 0.3}


def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1))
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1)) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, STEM, 1)), nn.ReLU(),
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))

        self.raw = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, RAW, 1))
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH + RAW, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64)), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = init_layer(nn.Linear(64, 1), 0.01)
        self.value_head = init_layer(nn.Linear(64, 1), 1.0)

        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.gn1(self.c1(s)))

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

W1 = 128
W3 = 64
HID = 48
GW = 64

def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


def cell_ln(ln, x):
    return ln(x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.l1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, W1, 1))
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(W1)
        self.l2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(W1, W1, 1))
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(W1)
        self.l3 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(W1, W3, 1))
        self.exact = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(W3, HID, (dy, dx))) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])
        self.anchor = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(W3, 1, 1), 0.01)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * W3, GW)), nn.ReLU())
        self.type_term = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_types), 0.01)
        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)
        self.value = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 1.0)

        h = F.relu(cell_ln(self.ln1, self.l1(obs)))
        h = F.relu(h + cell_ln(self.ln2, self.l2(h)))
        h = F.relu(self.l3(h))
        res = []

            q = F.pad(h, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(ex(q))))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        place = torch.cat(res, 1) + self.anchor(h) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        logits = torch.cat([place.flatten(1), self.done(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GW = 64

def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


class PoolExactHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1))
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1)) for _ in self.fps])
        self.exact = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx))) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = F.relu(self.proj(f))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, ex, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.exact, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], 1)) + ex(q))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, 1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, STEM, 1)), nn.ReLU(),
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn1 = nn.GroupNorm(8, WIDTH)
        self.c2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn2 = nn.GroupNorm(8, WIDTH)
        self.head = PoolExactHead(WIDTH + COL, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + COL, GW)), nn.ReLU())
        self.type_term = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_types), 0.01)
        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)
        self.value = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):

        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)

        place = self.head(torch.cat([f, s], 1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), s.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        place = place + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        logits = torch.cat([place.flatten(1), self.done(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, STEM, 1)), nn.ReLU(),
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))

        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)

        place = torch.cat(res, 1) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        d = F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1)
        place = place.flatten(1) + self.dense(d)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
K = 6
PROJ = 24
HID = 32
GW = 64
DONE_SCALE = 0.1

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}


def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


def fpad(x, dy, dx):
    return F.pad(x, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))


def maxp(x, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return x
    return F.max_pool2d(fpad(x, dy, dx), (dy, dx), stride=1)


def minp(x, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return x
    return -F.max_pool2d(-fpad(x, dy, dx), (dy, dx), stride=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = spec.in_channels
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, STEM, 1)), nn.ReLU(),
            init_layer(nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn1 = nn.GroupNorm(8, WIDTH)
        self.c2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn2 = nn.GroupNorm(8, WIDTH)
        fin = WIDTH + COL + C
        self.hgt = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(fin, spec.Z, 1), 1.0)
        self.cell = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(fin, spec.Z * K, 1), 1.0)
        self.proj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(fin, PROJ, 1))
        self.exact = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HID, (dy, dx))) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(2 * K, HID, 1)) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + COL, GW)), nn.ReLU())
        self.type_term = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_types), 0.01)
        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)
        self.value = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.gn1(self.c1(s)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.gn2(self.c2(x)))
        z = torch.cat([f, s, obs], 1)
        u = torch.sigmoid(self.hgt(z))
        m = torch.sigmoid(self.cell(z))
        p = F.relu(self.proj(z))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), ex, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.exact, self.mix, self.outs):
            U = maxp(u, dy, dx)
            prev = torch.cat([torch.ones_like(U[:, :1]), U[:, :-1]], 1)
            ell = (prev - U).unsqueeze(2)
            mn = minp(m, dy, dx).reshape(B, self.Z, K, Y, X)
            mx = maxp(m, dy, dx).reshape(B, self.Z, K, Y, X)
            a = (ell * mn).sum(1)
            b = (ell * mx).sum(1)
            h = F.relu(ex(fpad(p, dy, dx)) + mix(torch.cat([a, b], 1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), s.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        place = torch.cat(res, 1) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        done = DONE_SCALE * self.done(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place.flatten(1), done], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        a = m.reshape(B, T, Y, X)
        b = m.reshape(B, Y, X, T).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        c = m.reshape(B, T, X, Y).permute(0, 1, 3, 2)
        d = m.reshape(B, X, Y, T).permute(0, 3, 2, 1)
        return torch.cat([a, b, c, d], 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = self.mask_layouts(mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype), B)
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, m, yy, xx], 1)
        h = F.relu(cell_ln(self.ln1, self.l1(inp)))
        h = F.relu(h + cell_ln(self.ln2, self.l2(h)))
        h = F.relu(self.l3(h))
        x = F.relu(self.gn1(self.c1(h)))
        x = F.relu(x + self.gn2(self.c2(x)))
        feats = torch.cat([h, x], 1)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(feats))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([feats.mean((2, 3)), feats.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        S = self.hout(F.relu(self.h3(p))) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        w = torch.softmax(self.gate, 0)
        s0 = S.flatten(1)
        s1 = S.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).flatten(1)
        s2 = S.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).flatten(1)
        s3 = S.permute(0, 3, 2, 1).flatten(1)
        place = w[0] * s0 + w[1] * s1 + w[2] * s2 + w[3] * s3
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

CTX = 40

PROJ = 40
HID = 24
HH = 24
DCH = 4

def init_layer(m, gain=math.sqrt(2.0)):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


def cell_ln(ln, x):
    return ln(x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        C = spec.in_channels + spec.n_types + 2
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.l1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, COLW, 1))
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(COLW)
        self.l2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COLW, COLW, 1))
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(COLW)
        self.l3 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(COLW, MID, 1))
        self.c1 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(MID, CTX, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn1 = nn.GroupNorm(8, CTX)
        self.c2 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1))
        self.gn2 = nn.GroupNorm(8, CTX)
        self.film = init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * CTX, 2 * CTX), 0.1)
        self.raw = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(C, RAW, 1))
        self.proj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(MID + CTX + RAW, PROJ, 1))
        self.exact = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HID, (dy, dx))) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([init_layer(nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1), 0.01) for _ in self.fps])
        self.h3 = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HH, 3, padding=1))
        self.hout = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(HH, spec.n_types, 1), 0.01)
        self.anchor = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, 1, 1), 0.01)
        self.dproj = init_layer(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, DCH, 1))
        self.dense = init_layer(nn.Linear(DCH * spec.Y * spec.X, spec.n_place), 0.01)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(init_layer(nn.Linear(2 * (MID + CTX), GW)), nn.ReLU())
        self.type_term = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, spec.n_types), 0.01)
        self.done = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 0.01)
        self.beta = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
        self.value = init_layer(nn.Linear(GW, 1), 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, m, yy, xx], 1)
        h = F.relu(cell_ln(self.ln1, self.l1(inp)))
        h = F.relu(h + cell_ln(self.ln2, self.l2(h)))
        h = F.relu(self.l3(h))
        x = F.relu(self.gn1(self.c1(h)))
        x = F.relu(x + self.gn2(self.c2(x)))
        gb = self.film(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        gam, bet = gb.chunk(2, dim=1)
        x = F.relu(x * (1.0 + gam[:, :, None, None]) + bet[:, :, None, None])
        r = self.raw(inp)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(torch.cat([h, x, r], 1)))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), ex, out in zip(self.fps, self.exact, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(ex(q))))
        feats = torch.cat([h, x], 1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([feats.mean((2, 3)), feats.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        loc = torch.cat(res, 1) + self.hout(F.relu(self.h3(p))) + self.anchor(p) + self.type_term(g)[:, :, None, None]
        d = F.relu(self.dproj(p)).flatten(1)
        place = loc.flatten(1) + self.dense(d)
        done = self.done(g) - self.beta * torch.logsumexp(place, 1, keepdim=True)
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)

analyses.2: All 6 round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and on training success. Earlier searches got the same. They covered many different heads, trunks, kinds of initialisation and recipes. When every idea gives exactly 0, the cause is likely shared by all of them, not the architecture. One candidate is collapse to an early DONE. With the starting uniform policy, a random placement has negative expected reward, because most cells it fills are wrong. DONE always returns 0, and it is a single logit that collects all the positive advantage. So PPO may learn to press DONE at once. Episodes then last 1 step, and placement is never learned. A DONE bias of -2 cannot stop this, because Adam quickly moves the bias. This round tests ways to change how the DONE logit learns. One way scales it so it learns more slowly. Another caps it at 0 or below, so DONE wins only when every placement logit is low. Each fix sits on a different trunk, head and recipe.
